lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when two independent checks format pre check and digest verification can both reject the same bad input with the same wrapped error code assert on the specific rejection cause message not just the error code so removing either check is independently detected
lessons.text: When two independent checks (format pre-check and digest verification) can both reject the same bad input with the same wrapped error code, assert on the specific rejection cause/message, not just the error code, so removing either check is independently detected.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when multiple pre existing test assertions are updated across a slice to track a format change enumerate every changed file in the handoff s decisions section as each change lands not just a running count fixed at the end an implementer can lose track of one across multiple tasks t7 t8 t9
lessons.text: When multiple pre-existing test assertions are updated across a slice to track a format change, enumerate every changed file in the handoff's Decisions section as each change lands, not just a running count fixed at the end — an implementer can lose track of one across multiple tasks (T7/T8/T9).
evidence: handoff.md Decisions section / spec.md CJ-12 evidence (.specs/features)

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a requirement reads when the candidate is given x a test that exercises x in isolation satisfies nothing assert that the production path actually issues it or the requirement is vacuously true while the mechanism sits unwired
lessons.text: When a requirement reads 'WHEN the candidate is given X', a test that exercises X in isolation satisfies nothing: assert that the production path actually issues it, or the requirement is vacuously true while the mechanism sits unwired.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::forge exactly one field per negative test a blunt forgery that breaks several things at once trips whichever guard fires first so every other guard survives its own deletion undetected
lessons.text: Forge exactly one field per negative test: a blunt forgery that breaks several things at once trips whichever guard fires first, so every other guard survives its own deletion undetected.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a sensor shows a guard is unkillable decide which it is subsumed by a later check delete it or enforced by the type checker say so in place an unkillable guard left unexplained reads as defence and is decoration
lessons.text: When a sensor shows a guard is unkillable, decide which it is: subsumed by a later check (delete it) or enforced by the type checker (say so in place) -- an unkillable guard left unexplained reads as defence and is decoration.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::prove a denied write through the same state it would have written to a second instance built from the same inputs has its own copy and cannot see the write so denied and changed nothing passes even when the write happened
lessons.text: Prove a denied write through the same state it would have written to; a second instance built from the same inputs has its own copy and cannot see the write, so 'denied and changed nothing' passes even when the write happened.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a decision record must not assert a change it did not make ad 018 claimed issue 15 is corrected when only a comment had been added so the tracked scope and the decision log disagreed until a verifier checked the issue body itself
lessons.text: A decision record must not assert a change it did not make: AD-018 claimed 'issue #15 is corrected' when only a comment had been added, so the tracked scope and the decision log disagreed until a verifier checked the issue body itself.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when an artifact merges a reviewed declaration with observed evidence reconciling the two is the product copying declared statuses through and appending observations alongside let an all red fleet publish a green verdict call it a join only if an observation can downgrade a declared status
lessons.text: When an artifact merges a reviewed declaration with observed evidence, reconciling the two IS the product: copying declared statuses through and appending observations alongside let an all-red fleet publish a green verdict. Call it a join only if an observation can downgrade a declared status.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a rule applied to one dimension is not applied after reconciling the platform dimension the same fleet evidence answered gate profile and stayed concatenated so the headline run asserted a profile qualified with nothing observing it enumerate every input the rule s own justification covers
lessons.text: A rule applied to one dimension is not applied. After reconciling the platform dimension, the same fleet evidence answered gate-profile and stayed concatenated, so the headline run asserted a profile qualified with nothing observing it. Enumerate every input the rule's own justification covers.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::never let the artifact under verification decide how strictly it is verified excusing a case because its declaration said environmental let a leg run and fail in every dispatch with zero contradictions each non qualified status must declare which observations it predicts anything outside that set is a contradiction
lessons.text: Never let the artifact under verification decide how strictly it is verified. Excusing a case because its declaration said environmental let a leg run and fail in every dispatch with zero contradictions. Each non-qualified status must declare which observations it predicts; anything outside that set is a contradiction.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a check becomes per item in one direction make the opposite direction per item too a per observation inconsistency rule beside a unanimity only staleness rule silently ignored a partial change of state and partial is the shape real state changes have
lessons.text: When a check becomes per-item in one direction, make the opposite direction per-item too. A per-observation inconsistency rule beside a unanimity-only staleness rule silently ignored a partial change of state, and partial is the shape real state changes have.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a fixture that cannot express the failing case cannot detect it fleet fixtures holding only qualified and missing left six mutants alive against a producer emitting four statuses and an absent item yields no observation so a test meant to prove non unanimous detection was still unanimous
lessons.text: A fixture that cannot express the failing case cannot detect it. Fleet fixtures holding only qualified and missing left six mutants alive against a producer emitting four statuses; and an absent item yields no observation, so a test meant to prove non-unanimous detection was still unanimous.
evidence: S3/S4 unpinned round-3 and round-4 fixes (tests)
